1. Getting to the hole in the Green Claw Swamp

Travel to the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}, between Kazordoon and Venore. If you are coming from another city, take the boat to **Venore** (say {key:hi}, {key:venore} and {key:yes} to the captain). You can get there from the west of Venore, walking **east** from the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, or cross the swamp from the **northwest** entrance of Venore.
On the surface there are {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}; on the way you may also meet {creature:Amazon|Amazons}.
Look for the hole on the **north** side of the swamp and go down.

After going down the hole, go straight **west** and go down one more floor.

Luring the Witches one by one
On this floor there are **3 {creature:Witch|Witches}**. Use the corners at the entrance to lure them one at a time.

Bring healing runes or spells for this fight.
The quest boxes are in the big room to the **east**, against the **east** wall. Open both.
Voodoo Doll (King) and Magic Light Wand

Go back the same way: return **west**, go up to the floor above, go **east** to the spot where you fell and use the {item:Rope} to climb the hole up to the swamp. Then go back to **Venore** by the city's **northwest** entrance (or west to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}).
